The commit hook is fine (enforce.py same_tree rule). Workaround today: release/re-claim with --agent <old id> (as_agent over MCP). Fix: treat the bare derived id of THIS clone as an alias of the suffixed one for leases whose holder equals it, only when this clone has no shard/lease under the suffixed id for that item — and say so in `ddflow identify`. Regression test: claim under the bare id, create .ddflow/local/clone-id, heartbeat must succeed.

data.body: Critic (Qwen) on B22, cmd_pins: with --json, an Outcome exit 1 prints only out.reason to stderr and nothing on stdout; exit 2 prints out.body(). The same shape is the house convention in cmd_cadence, cmd_research, cmd_bug_fixed, setup, workflow, review and queue (grep 'exit == FAIL' ddflow/surfaces/commands), so the fix is one helper in surfaces/context (e.g. Ctx.fail(out) emitting {"error": reason, "exit": 1, ...data} under --json, reason on stderr always), applied everywhere, not a per-command patch. MCP already returns isError with the reason. Test: every command's --json failure path parses as JSON.
data.title: --json failures are not machine-readable: FAIL prints the reason to stderr and no JSON body, while exit 2 prints one

definition.body: Seen on B190 (2026-09-28): the critic review took 2055 s over 6 chunks; the Claude Code MCP client aborted at 1800 s with no progress notification. The gate was recorded (partial, 2 findings) but the evidence holds only finding TITLES, so the findings themselves existed only in the lost tool response — the review had to be re-run from the CLI (another ~35 min). Fix: (1) store each finding's body/claim/probe in the gate evidence or an output_file under .ddflow/local/reviews/ whose digest is recorded; (2) emit MCP progress notifications per chunk so the client's idle timer resets. Regression test: a fake reviewer returning a finding; the recorded evidence carries its body.

data.body: Dedupe sweep 2026-09-28 (after B22): `path.relative_to(repo).as_posix() if path.is_relative_to(repo) else str(path)` appears at api/operations.py (pins, document) and services/prosepin.py (coverage, per test file), identical; enforce._rel resolves both sides but returns native separators and no relpath fallback; worktree.store_path resolves, tries relpath, as_posix. Probe of the drift: api.pins(Path('/tmp/link-to-repo'), 'R.md') reports tests as absolute '/tmp/real/tests/test_a.py' because test_files() resolves and the repo argument is not; the CLI hides it by resolving --repo. Fix: route the three through store_path (or a renamed infra helper) and add a test calling api.pins with a symlinked repo expecting 'tests/test_a.py'.
